purpose: Create the next twelve evidence-backed GitHub planning milestones after M01-M12.
authority_boundary: GitHub milestone and issue metadata are planning surfaces only; they create no KFM evidence, policy approval, lifecycle promotion, release, deployment, or publication authority.

notes: No open pull requests were returned at this checkpoint, so no active branch owns the milestone-tool or manifest paths.
No due dates are declared because the inspected evidence does not support a defensible schedule.
The issue mappings cover all ten open issues observed at this checkpoint; four milestones intentionally have no speculative issue assignments.

milestones.title: M13 — Security Operations & Fail-Closed Exposure Assurance
milestones.description: Operationalize private vulnerability intake, accountable incident roles, scanning response, and fail-closed sensitive exposure. Include issue #3022's wholly fictional critical-facility proof across API, map/tile, Evidence Drawer, generated language, logs, catalogs, exports, caches, offline packages, and cross-lane joins. Exit when deterministic no-network denial evidence or a precise HOLD is recorded; no real facility data is admitted or published.

milestones.title: M14 — Quality Engineering, Regression Ratchets & Test Governance
milestones.description: Establish changed-area and safety checks, deterministic no-network fixtures, positive and negative polarity, replay, rollback tests, accessibility, performance, flaky-test handling, and quality evidence. Exit when quality claims are tied to executable checks and inherited failures are separated from introduced failures; passing tests remain bounded evidence rather than release authority.

milestones.title: M15 — Hosted CI, Branch Protection & Workflow Convergence
milestones.description: Converge hosted CI and workflow governance: exact-head behavior, immutable action pins, least privilege, bounded timeouts, artifact isolation, required-check mapping, and branch/ruleset evidence. Exit when workflow duplication and security findings are classified and the protected-branch check set is documented from current evidence without weakening a gate or changing settings by implication.

milestones.title: M16 — Supply Chain, Containers, SBOMs & Artifact Attestation
milestones.description: Harden dependencies, containers, SBOMs, and attestations. Cover lock integrity, advisory handling, digest-pinned bases, non-root runtime checks, image scanning, SBOM generation, OCI provenance/signature verification, exception expiry, and rollback/removal. Exit when representative artifacts have immutable identity and verified supply-chain evidence in an approved test path; no scan or signature gate is bypassed.

milestones.title: M17 — Program Reconciliation & Repository Conformance
milestones.description: Close issues #2768 and #2874 by reconciling the supplied corpus with current main, accepted ADRs, Directory Rules, contracts, schemas, policy, validators, workflows, receipts, runtime surfaces, and recent merges. Exit with a commit-pinned ledger, a current program board, explicit HOLDs for unresolved authority, and dependency-closed next slices with validation and rollback.

milestones.title: M18 — Evidence Resolver & Inspectable Claim Closure
milestones.description: Complete issue #2975 as the first deterministic EvidenceRef-to-EvidenceBundle governed-consumer seam. Reuse current profiles, repository abstractions, finite envelopes, identity/digest, policy/review/release, citations, freshness, and correction lineage. Exit with one synthetic end-to-end supported case plus stable ABSTAIN, DENY, and ERROR cases, no network/model calls, and no restricted payload or internal-path leak.

milestones.title: M19 — Temporal Authority Compatibility & Historical Replay
milestones.description: Complete issue #2990's compatibility-first temporal split. Preserve the common TemporalAuthorityEnvelope, add the distinctly named evidence temporal-posture assessment, and keep the legacy evidence family as an exact-shape alias until removal gates close. Exit with replay equivalence, cross-family rejection, stable Advisory identity, classified references, immutable historical receipts, a successor receipt, no-network replay, and rollback.

milestones.title: M20 — Kansas Transportation Geometry & Source Admission
milestones.description: Advance issue #2898 through separate assessments for NG911, K-Hub/LRS, mobile LiDAR derivatives, and supporting DASC layers. Keep geometry, attributes, observations, rights, cadence, precision, identity, and correction semantics separate. Exit with a finite disposition per lane, bounded crosswalk/identity questions, recorded CRS/pagination/terms/sensitivity, and a synthetic fixture profile; no source activation or publication.

milestones.title: M21 — Western Kansas Drought & Hydrology Evidence Envelope
milestones.description: Complete issue #2899's synthetic-first western Kansas drought and hydrology envelope. Preserve separate source families and observation, validity, publication, retrieval, revision, correction, and withdrawal times. Exit with deterministic support-preserving joins; OBSERVED, DERIVED, CONFLICT, STALE, ABSTAIN, missing, corrected, and superseded fixtures; prohibited-inference negatives; and no groundwater, crop-loss, or emergency claim.

milestones.title: M22 — MapLibre Architecture Decision & 6.4 Runtime Readiness
milestones.description: Resolve issues #2957 and #2906 in dependency order: decide the MapLibre adapter/package/import/dependency/renderer boundary, then execute the authenticated 6.4.0 browser and long-session packet. Exit with explicit ADR dispositions and immutable PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN evidence for CSP, PMTiles, terrain, tile churn, queries, resource reclamation, Evidence Drawer selection, visual/headless parity, teardown, and rollback; readiness is not dependency admission.

milestones.title: M23 — GeoParquet 2.0 RC Carrier Interoperability
milestones.description: Execute issue #2907's pinned GeoParquet 2.0 RC carrier-byte matrix while retaining 1.1 as default. Authenticate GDAL, DuckDB Spatial, SedonaSpark, SedonaDB, PyArrow, JVM/Scala/parquet-java, containers, extensions, and carriers. Exit with explicit logical-type, WKB, CRS, metadata, null/empty/mixed geometry, statistics/pruning, malformed-carrier, and 1.1 results bound to immutable digests and correction lineage; no default change is inferred.

milestones.title: M24 — Observability, Resilience, Correction & Recovery Readiness
milestones.description: Prove operational behavior rather than infer it from repository bytes. Define health indicators, SLOs, safe logs/metrics/traces, audit retention, backup/restore, cache invalidation, correction/withdrawal propagation, deterministic replay, disaster recovery, incident ownership, and rollback across governed API, Explorer, evidence, catalog, release, and AI-supporting surfaces. Exit with recorded synthetic drills, explicit RTO/RPO or UNKNOWNs, and no unsafe fallback.
